description: This Java source file defines Swagger API response models for the Self Clients API in the Fineract project, including classes for client details, accounts, charges, and transactions.

classes.name: SelfClientsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger API response models for self client data.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response for retrieving a list of self clients, including pagination info.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsPageItems
classes.description: Represents individual client summary items within the list.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a client, including id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Represents detailed information for a specific client identified by ID.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsTimeline
classes.description: Tracks submission and activation dates and users for a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdAccountsResponse
classes.description: Contains account details, including loan and savings accounts.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccounts
classes.description: Details of loan accounts associated with a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccountsStatus
classes.description: Status details of a loan account.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccountsType
classes.description: Type information for a loan account.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccounts
classes.description: Details of savings accounts associated with a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccountsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details for a savings account.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccountsStatus
classes.description: Status details for a savings account.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Contains charges related to a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargesPageItems
classes.description: Details of individual charges.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargeTimeType
classes.description: Type of charge timing.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargeCalculationType
classes.description: Type of charge calculation.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Details of a specific charge by charge ID.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsResponse
classes.description: Transaction history for a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsPageItems
classes.description: Individual transaction entries.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsType
classes.description: Type of transaction.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Details of a specific transaction by transaction ID.
